Module io.github.jpersist.tools.hibernate.orm
Package hibernate.jakarta.persistence.tools

Class HibernateEntityModelLinter

java.lang.Object
hibernate.base.persistence.tools.AbstractEntityModelLinter
hibernate.jakarta.persistence.tools.HibernateEntityModelLinter
All Implemented Interfaces:
EntityModelLinter, PersistenceLinter
public class HibernateEntityModelLinter extends AbstractEntityModelLinter
Hibernate ORM 6 and Jakarta Persistence implementation of EntityModelLinter.

Inherits standard reflection checks from AbstractEntityModelLinter (such as non-final entity class rules, accessible no-arg constructors, and non-final getter/setter methods) and inspects jakarta.persistence relationship annotations across fields and property getter methods:

  • EntityLintRule.EAGER_TO_MANY_ASSOCIATION – flags @OneToMany and @ManyToMany associations configured with FetchType.EAGER.
  • EntityLintRule.MISSING_MAPPED_BY – flags bidirectional @OneToMany associations omitting the mappedBy attribute.
  • EntityLintRule.EAGER_TO_ONE_ASSOCIATION – flags @ManyToOne and @OneToOne associations configured with FetchType.EAGER.
  • EntityLintRule.UNORDERED_MANY_TO_MANY_LIST – flags @ManyToMany associations typed as List without an accompanying OrderColumn annotation.
Since:
2.2.0

      public static HibernateEntityModelLinter of(List<String> entityClassNames, ClassLoader classLoader)
      Creates a new HibernateEntityModelLinter for the given entity class names and class loader.
      Parameters:
      entityClassNames - the list of fully-qualified entity class names to inspect; must not be null
      classLoader - the class loader used to load and inspect entity classes; must not be null
      Returns:
      a new HibernateEntityModelLinter instance
      Throws:

    • lintEntityModel

      protected void lintEntityModel(Class<?> entityClass, List<LintDiagnostic> diagnostics)
      Hook for concrete Hibernate 5 (javax) and Hibernate ORM 6 (jakarta) implementations to inspect JPA annotations and Hibernate boot metadata.

      Inspects declared fields and getter methods for jakarta.persistence association annotations and evaluates them against standard anti-pattern rules.

      Specified by:
      lintEntityModel in class AbstractEntityModelLinter
      Parameters:
      entityClass - the loaded entity class being inspected
      diagnostics - mutable list to collect discovered LintDiagnostic findings
